This writ petition is filed seeking the following reliefs:
"1.
To call for the records leading to Exhibit-P18 letter and to quash the same by issuing a writ of certiorari.

2 . To issue a writ of mandamus or any other appropriate writ, order or direction commanding the respondents to issue separate building number to the building leased out for running shop or permit to use the same building number already assigned (9/83) and issue license to the shop 'Ms Amazone Fresh Outlet' at the earliest.
3. And to pass such other appropriate writs, orders or directions which this Hon'ble Court deems fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case so as to secure the ends of justice.
4. The petitioner also prays that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to dispense with the translation of the document produced in Vernacular Language."

[SIC] 
2.

The petitioner is aggrieved by Ext.P18 communication issued by the Assistant Engineer, LID &
EW Section, Malampuzha Grama Panchayath.
The 2025:KER:83720 petitioner has got serious contentions against Ext.P18.

sentences.text: 3. Heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and the learned Government Pleader.

4. After hearing both sides, I am of the considered opinion that the petitioner can be allowed to submit his grievance against Ext.P18 to the 2 nd respondent Panchayath and the 2 nd respondent can be directed to consider the same with notice to the petitioner.

Therefore, this Writ Petition(C) is disposed of with the following directions:
1. The petitioner is free to submit his objection against Ext.P18 to the 2nd respondent Panchayath, within a period of two weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment.
2.

Once such an objection is received, the 2nd respondent Panchayath will hear the petitioner and thereafter pass appropriate 2025:KER:83720 orders in it, as expeditiously as possible, at any rate, within a period of two weeks from the date of receipt of the objection.

Sd/-
 P.V.KUNHIKRISHNAN,
